stuck._doc: stuck.py: a queue whose oldest activity waited this long is stuck; restart_hosts get an MDM restart (max per day), others only an alert. 635 is the physical NucBox people use (it hosts the findings VM): alert only.

disk._doc: disk.py: a soak host below min_gb free alerts once ("Soak host low on disk" issue); it clears once back above min_gb + hysteresis_gb.

held._doc: held.py: once a day, quarantine entries and harness leftovers held this many days go to the "Soak items held over 3 days" issue.

replace_preexisting._doc: runner.py: when an app is already on the host and the harness didn't install it, uninstall it with the FMA's uninstall script and test the FMA (Brayan, 2026-11-05). Otherwise the cycle is skipped. except_hosts: hosts where existing apps are never removed (635 is the physical NucBox people use). keep: slugs never removed (fleetd's own Desktop).

allow._doc: except_hosts exceptions: apps that may be replaced there anyway, approved by Brayan 2026-11-08 to complete the catalog. Reinstalled at the catalog version when the cycle ends (runner.restore).

recheck.note: closed FMA catalog bugs rerun on the host that found them, at least settle_minutes after the close (fixes ship ~1 h after merge); recheck.py
recheck.label: ~fma-soak

title_cleanup._doc: titles.py sweep (report job, after every soak and pool job): removes the soak's FMA titles from the soak fleet so stored installers don't fill the instance's disk (#57132 on qa.fleetdm.com, 2026-11-06). keep_title_ids: titles Brayan added before the soak (fleet 65 activity log, 2026-11-07); canaries, residents, patch_closed apps, apps still on a host and queued titles are kept by rule.

coverage._doc: sample.py: a lifecycle cycle started inside an invalid window that didn't pass doesn't count as coverage, so the app goes back to catch-up for a clean run. Times are local, like records.

invalid_windows.why: qa installer store full (#57132): adds 500 'no space left', installs 'image not recognized'

rerun._doc: sample.py: these apps go first, once each, until one has a lifecycle cycle started after `since` (local time, like records). 2026-11-07: apps whose only failures came from qa's full installer store (#57132) with errors a wrong install script also gives, and no clean install before it; yacreader/windows had non-install findings in a broken run. Triage marked them environment (triage.json); a clean run proves it, a failure comes back as a new finding. 35 of 37 ran 2026-11-07 (34 clean or flaky-uninstall only; goldendict-ng/windows a new finding); mist and shifty were skipped (pool host missed the presence query), queued again and passed 2026-11-08 00:46/00:56. 2026-11-08: grammarly-desktop/darwin (host-specific relaunch failure on 636). 2026-11-08 22:45: zoom-rooms/darwin (one unexplained 400 on the second uninstall). 2026-11-09: hex-fiend/darwin (stuck pending on 636 in the afternoon install-delivery stall); since moved to 2026-11-09T16:00, so grammarly and zoom-rooms get one more pass too. 2026-11-10: grammarly-desktop, zoom-rooms and hex-fiend reran after 2026-11-09 16:00 (done); fellow/windows queued (uninstall left AppData\\Local\\Fellow on a congested 629, once).
rerun.why: clean rerun: fellow/windows uninstall failed to remove AppData\Local\Fellow on 629 while its queue was backed up (2026-11-10 01:25); needs an idle-host run to tell a short wait from congestion
